item: Row 328: the import queue refuses a half-migrated store or a blocking writer when the run starts
summary: The queue's start asked only about the backups (manifests, passphrases), so a corpus a country-code migration left half done (R788) or a writer the restore may not stop (R659, an export: R712) refused each item only once it ran: after the collection pause, and a refusal in a checkpoint group discarded the merges it held. The start now asks both first, in run_restore's order (half-migrated, then writer-jobs), through refuse_half_migrated_store and a new side-effect-free writer_jobs_refusal that refuse_while_writer_jobs_run now shares; a job the restore may stop (the re-index drain) is not stopped by the start, and a start with nothing to restore asks neither. The words are the restore's existing fixed sentences, so no new text.
